subject: Capacity handshake: AstraTech deal mapping to reserved pools
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, AstraTech - Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@astratech.co>
Cc: procurement@astratech.co
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity handshake: AstraTech deal mapping to reserved pools

Team / Sarah —

Quick note ahead of today's capacity sync: AstraTech (deal D-2026-0421) is asking us to lock in a dedicated/reserved footprint for their production rollout starting 2026-10-01. Attached is the intake sheet with their current forecast and token profile (capacity_requirements_sheet.xlsx).

High-level ask: can we confirm a mapping from their forecast to 1) reserved pool(s) they should own, and 2) burst eligibility and credit sizing?

Summary of AstraTech ask (from sales ops):
- Expected steady-state inference qps: 120 requests/sec (short-form, avg 40 tokens/respond)
- Peak ramp windows: up to 350 req/sec for 3-hour daily windows during product launches (anticipated month 2 and month 4 after launch)
- Embedding usage: batch embedding jobs overnight (~1M vectors/day)
- SLA target: p95 latency < 250ms for generation path

Initial proposal (draft):
- Reserve: 3xA100-80GB equivalent reserved slots for inference-critical routes (handle steady-state + baseline safety margin)
- Dedicated H100 bucket for embeddings batch windows (2 reserved slots) with scheduled offload to spot during low use
- Burst credits: 50% of reserved capacity available as burst for first 90 days, then evaluated based on observed utilization

Questions for owners:
- Jordan/Infra: can fleet support the 3xA100 steady mapping and nightly embedding batch without impacting other reserved pools? Any constraints on hot-swapping pool sizes?
- Ben/Finance: what minimum commit (monthly hours / $) do we need to hit to reserve the above and keep price close to the current OC?
- Laura/Sales Ops: can you confirm AstraTech's ramp timeline and whether they will sign an annual commit vs quarterly? (this impacts how aggressive we should be on reserved sizing)

I attached the intake and a quick snapshot (fleet_allocation_snapshot.png). If we can get a short reply with rough capacity OK/no-go we can lock the MCA draft and send to procurement.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: capacity_requirements_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), fleet_allocation_snapshot.png (image)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, AstraTech - Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@astratech.co>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handshake: AstraTech deal mapping to reserved pools

Thanks Mina — quick read. A few clarifying items from infra ops perspective: 

1) Peak concurrency: the 350 req/sec peak matters a lot for batching efficiency. Do you know expected average sequence length during that window? If it's short (<= 64 tokens) we can hit <250ms on A100; if longer we should consider an H100 path for those windows.

2) Embeddings: 1M vectors/day overnight is reasonable if we schedule the batch into a reserved H100 window; otherwise it will push competition into daytime. We need the cron window (start/end) to be explicit.

3) Hot-swap: we can hot-swap 1 slot between pools within a 24-48h window if there is no conflicting reserve commitment. If AstraTech signs an annual commit we should avoid relying on hot-swaps during their SLA period.

I'm happy to take point with Ben on what the minimal commit looks like to allocate 3xA100 + 2xH100.

Jordan
Infra Lead — Fleet

Thanks Mina & Jordan. Quick answers from our side: 
- Peak sequences during launch spikes are short — median 28 tokens, 95th pct 72 tokens.
- Nightly embeddings window: 01:00–05:00 PT (we can be flexible +/- 1 hour).
- Contract: leaning toward annual commit but final procurement will confirm. We want at least a 6-month guaranteed runway.
- Burst credits: if you offer an initial buffer (one-time pool of burst credits usable across months) that would make us comfortable signing annual. Can you share a sample MCA with the suggested commit + burst tranche?

Sarah Kim
Head of AI Platform — AstraTech

Attachment: N/A
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@astratech.co>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handshake: AstraTech deal mapping to reserved pools

All — based on Sarah's numbers, here's a conservative allocation model we can commit to: 

- Reserved allocation: 3xA100-80GB (handles 120 steady qps + margin)
- Embedding bucket: 2xH100 reserved for nightly batch window 01:00–05:00 PT (can be scheduled)
- Short-term burst credit: 1.5x equivalent of reserved capacity (applies to generation routes only) for first 90 days, reviewed at 30/60/90 days
- Minimum commit request for pricing tier: 12-month term at 70% utilization baseline -> shows as monthly commitment of ~5,040 reserved GPU hours (MCA baseline).

I've uploaded a draft MCA with the commit numbers (MCA_Draft_v2.docx) to the Drive link — Ben will coordinate with finance on discount band. If AstraTech can confirm annual, we can tighten pricing to the next band.

Action items: 
- Jordan: validate nos. above vs pool-level impact and confirm hot-swap constraints (24–48h)
- Mina/Laura: get procurement confirmation on annual vs 6-month and tick the MCA link

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations

Attachments: MCA_Draft_v2.docx (draft contract)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@astratech.co>
Cc: procurement@astratech.co
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity handshake: AstraTech deal mapping to reserved pools — decisions and next steps

Thanks everyone — brief summary to lock the thread: 

Decisions: 
- Reserve 3xA100-80GB for AstraTech generation routes effective 2026-10-01 (subject to signed MCA).
- Reserve 2xH100 for nightly embedding window 01:00–05:00 PT; scheduled job to be configured by AstraTech engineering.
- Grant one-time burst tranche equal to 1.5x reserved capacity for first 90 days; ops to meter and report usage weekly.
- Minimum pricing tier: 12-month commit at the 70% baseline that Ben outlined.

Next steps: 
- Ben: finalize MCA numbers and push updated doc to Drive (Ben -> finance) — target 2026-08-07 EOD.
- Jordan: confirm on-call runbook for hot-swap (24–48h) and update fleet orchestration constraints — target 2026-08-06 noon PT.
- Laura/Mina: coordinate with AstraTech procurement to confirm annual vs 6-month and return signed MCA — target 2026-08-12.

I'll close the loop once MCA is signed and schedule a capacity handover runbook session with infra.

Best —
Mina Haddad
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
